description: Two-column layout with a coloured header and section rules. Visually strong; parses less reliably in applicant tracking systems than the plain template.
notes: altacv.cls v1.7.4 by LianTze Lim, LPPL — vendored in assets/ and copied into the compile work directory.
atsRating is 'fair' on purpose: the two-column paracol layout and FontAwesome contact glyphs are exactly what ATS parsers mishandle. The UI should offer the ats-plain variant alongside it.
Needs a much larger TeX set than ats-plain (tikz, tcolorbox, academicons, simpleicons, pdfx, trimclip, extsizes) — see the render Dockerfile.
